newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris Club recommends Mozambique debt restructure.
newsitem.headline: Paris Club recommends Mozambique debt restructure.

text.p: The Paris Club of creditor countries said on Thursday it had decided to recommend a restructuring of the debt of the Republic of Mozambique under so-called Naples Terms with a two-thirds debt service cut.

It said the representatives agreed to recommend a plan providing for a debt reduction according to one of two options; either a 67 percent write-off of debt service obligations due under eligible loans and credits, or a consolidation at concessional interest rates which would reduce by 67 percent the net present value of payments due.
